verdicts.reason: Both rebuild the design sensibly as a skyscraper: stripe band up top, lime panel, stacked headline, CTA at the bottom. Both shrink the VOLTSTRIDE box to a small afterthought that straddles the stripe/lime seam, and both let the oversized 48H ONLY badge compete with the product. A spaces the badge and box apart more evenly, but its body copy runs almost to the side edges and nearly matches the headline in weight. In B the box is jammed right under a badge that dominates the stripe band, though B's smaller body copy has better margins. A is marginally the better resize.
